title: Reference handling — draft ticket wave
intro: One sheet per proposed ticket, in rank order. Compare the exact ticket body with its spec and source evidence. Annotate any span before publication.

tickets.title: Align the checklist with reference handling
tickets.body:
## What
Update the review checklist to include the reference label.

## Why now
The old checklist mentions only the value.

## Done when
The checklist and the reference rule agree.

spec.label: Spec §2 — checklist
spec.markdown: The checklist names both the label and value. Keep one authoritative rule and link to it.

tickets.title: Preserve reference labels alongside values
tickets.body:
## What
Keep both parts of a printed reference:
- the label
  - retain its original spelling
- the value

## Why now
A value without its label is ambiguous.

## Done when
A fixture proves both parts survive extraction.

spec.label: Spec §1 — references
spec.markdown:
## Rule
Retain the reference's label and value together.

| Input | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Label + value | Both retained |

sources.quote: Keep the label and the value together.

tickets.rulings: - Use the printed label; infer nothing.

other_actions.markdown: Record that the label-only question is answered by Spec §1.

panels.title: Deploy gate and rollout
panels.markdown:
1. Prove the change on a test copy.
2. Obtain authorization before production writes.
3. Record the actual deployed revision separately from merge evidence.

panels.title: No ticket — recap
panels.markdown: Send the reviewed reference rule to the operator.
